Aim for the restrained 32x32 native game inventory style enlarged for a 128x128 source master: extremely simple compact pixel-art clusters, about 32 logical pixels across, flat matte materials, muted brown timber and restrained gray metal, 3-4 value bands per material, crisp readable silhouette, tiny upper-left highlights.
